task: Stop the air-gap license-gate test and two CA-validity checks from failing as the calendar advances (make test broke on main on 2026-11-24)

events.summary: Test fixtures only. The bundle validator, its 90-day maximum age and the promotion gate are not changed.

On unmodified main and on two unrelated branches make test failed R82c and R86c on 2026-11-24. The license-gate test passed a fixture with created_at 2026-08-25 to the real validator, which rejects bundles older than 90 days. R86c runs the whole scripts/airgap/tests directory and failed for the same test.
evidence: test:make test (main, 2026-11-24) -> passed 503 failed 3; regressions: R19 R82c R86c (R19 is a stale local bundle directory in that checkout, not this defect)
test:python3 -m unittest scripts/airgap/tests/test_upgrade_license_gate.py -> AssertionError: 1 != 0 : ERROR: bundle is 91d old (max 90d): created_at=2026-08-25T00:00:00Z

events.summary: test_upgrade_license_gate.py builds created_at relative to the current time and adds a test that a 91-day-old bundle is rejected. check-push-security-db-ca.py and check-kisa-node-trust-psa-rbac.py generate expired and not-yet-valid certificates with offsets relative to now instead of fixed years (2030, 2098).

events.scope: Static regression suite and the air-gap unit tests on the author's macOS host; no cluster involved.
events.summary: The suite passes again, and the stale-bundle rejection still works with the reference time moved one year forward.
evidence: test:python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/airgap/tests -> Ran 83 tests OK
test:verify-upgrade-bundle.py --now 2027-11-24T00:15:08Z --max-age-days 90 -> fresh bundle rc=0, 91-day-old bundle rc=1
test:make lint -> shellcheck passed; yamllint exited non-zero on pre-existing line-length errors in untouched files

events.summary: The three fixtures no longer compare a fixed timestamp against the wall clock. Not verified by the author: the certificate fixtures on Linux OpenSSL before CI ran; the independent reviewer noted that macOS system LibreSSL 3.3.6 lacks req -not_before/-not_after (pre-existing; the author host uses a newer OpenSSL).
Complete and verified within the stated scope (test fixtures; production gates unchanged)
